scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix contract
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.test:unit: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.generate:openapi: npm run generate --prefix contract && cp contract/tsp-output/@typespec/openapi3/openapi.yaml openapi.yaml
scripts.generate: npm run generate:openapi && npm run generate:client
